What's the easiest way to get [x] Unique/Charm?

A good way to get Uniques is gambling the base item until you get an Ancestral normal/magic/rare, then using the cube to remove all affixes (normal item.) Then, all you need to do is use the cube recipe to upgrade it to a Unique.
: Use the Jeweler recipe "Mythic amulet crafting", best used on a Paladin character as 3 out of 5 results are valuable items.
: Use the Cube recipe "upgrade white item to unique", best used on a Paladin character as they got smaller Unique outcomes.
: Use the Cube recipe "upgrade white item to unique", best used on a Paladin character as they got smaller Unique outcomes.
: Use the Cube recipe "upgrade white item to unique", best used on a Paladin character (BUG: Still craftable in S15/3.2.2) as they got smaller Unique outcomes.

Do I need to roll Weapon Damage on all weapons?
No, this affix only works with the weapon you're actively using (ie: assigned to your main damaging skill).
